hero.description: First of the Randlord mansions, Hohenheim. It was designed by Frank Emley (or William Leck) and was home to Sir Lionel Phillips and his wife Lady Florence Phillips. It was the first house built in Parktown in 1892-1894. Hohenheim was donated and converted onto the Otto Beit Convalescent Home in 1915, and was demolished in 1972, but a plaque remains in honor of this important building.
